Every learner has to be specified to some task, and use some prior knowledge about that task, in order to succeed. So far we have modeled our prior knowledge by restricting our output hypothesis to be a member of a chosen hypothesis class. When choosing this hypothesis class, we face a tradeoff, between a larger, or more complex, class that is more likely to have a small approximation error, and a more restricted class that would guarantee
